caseNameFull: Black v. Strand Black v. Brando, Administratrix Black v. Denver United States National Bank and Brando, Administratrix v. Black
attorneys: Leslie R. Bishop for petitioners in Nos. 543, 544 and 545 and for respondents in No. 653., Allen E. Susman for petitioners in No. 653 and for respondents in No. 544.

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Motion for issuance of a peremptory writ of certiorari in No. 543 denied. Certiorari denied.

Reported below: No. 543, 362 F. 2d 8; Nos. 544 and 653, 362 F. 2d 19; and No. 545, 362 F. 2d 38.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion or of these petitions.
